pe_assessment: Oct6 $935.68 /FY26 EPS$20.76=45.07x; removing disclosed $0.15 tariff benefit gives EPS$20.61 and45.40x (analyst normalisation). Vendor44.49x/forward37.41x use other earnings bases. FY FCF yield2.26% versus frozen market cap is demanding.
margin_analysis: FY operating margin=11.685/303.154=3.85%, versus10.383/275.235=3.77%. Net margin=9.226/303.154=3.04%, including membership fees in denominator.
debt_analysis: Cash$20.207bn+short investments$1.094bn versus stated debt$6.162bn excluding leases. CFO$15.825bn less PP&E$6.435bn gives FCF$9.390bn; liquidity and cash conversion are strong.
growth_outlook: FY sales+10.1%, adjusted comparable sales+6.6%, EPS+14.0%; tariff normalisation barely alters the operating-growth thesis.
key_risks: At45.4x normalised FY earnings, return depends on sustaining high growth or valuation premium; evidence supports quality more clearly than entry upside.
Working-capital contribution$2.328bn is part of CFO; FCF is not owner earnings after every lease obligation.
key_strengths: Positive FCF and liquid assets well above stated debt.
Membership fees$5.907bn versus$5.323bn support recurring economics.
summary: Costco has verified earnings growth, improving operating margin and a strong cash balance. Neutral reflects demanding entry valuation rather than missing debt or cash-flow data.
